summary:
Original National Domestic Violence Awareness Month Resolution of 2025

This resolution supports the goals and ideals of National Domestic Violence Awareness Month. Further, it expresses the sense that Congress should continue to raise awareness of and support programs to end domestic violence.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.
